text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Pokke! For my<n>present, I've made
my Special 100%<n>Sincere Parfait—I do hope you
enjoy<n>it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, no thanks. There's no way<n>that parfait's
gonna be safe to eat.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm hurt. Then how about I make it<n>from scratch in
front of your very<n>eyes?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so we get to see you put ice<n>cream in the
parfait glass, squeeze<n>whipped cream, and put a
cherry on<n>top and everything?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You're kidding... Now this I gotta see!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, it's a trap... Back out now<n>before it's too
late. If you want a<n>parfait, I'll treat you to one.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If it looks poisonous, I just won't eat<n>it! C'mon,
let's see what kinda<n>parfait Tachyon cooks up.
Yeah,<n>Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, what she said! You may probe<n>with your own
two eyes the depth of<n>my sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: My friend and I will keep an eye onyou...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A'ight then, let's do this! Parfait,<n>parfait. ♪
Tachyon's parfait. ♪
